$comment: Seeded by `aios repo-bootstrap` (AIO-602): starter seam rules for scripts/check-boundaries.mjs, EMPTY grandfather list. The rule IDs are fixed in the gate script; edit descriptions/grandfathers here as this repo defines its own seams. Grandfather entries are ratchet-only-down: every entry must be a REAL, measured coupling with a reason, never a projection.

rules.description: scripts/<cmd>/* is importable only via its own top-level barrel scripts/<cmd>.mjs, or from another file inside the same scripts/<cmd>/ directory (same-dir siblings). Anything else must go through the barrel.
hooks/** may import a top-level scripts/*.mjs barrel, but must never reach directly into a scripts/<cmd>/ subdirectory — hooks depend only on stable public entry points.
src/** must never import scripts/** — library/product code is a client of the tooling layer, never the reverse.
gui/server must not deep-import scripts/** at all, at any depth — cross-surface access goes through CLI --json output or a published package contract.
Nothing outside test/** may import test/**. Tests are a leaf: fixtures and helpers stay test-only, never a dependency of production code.

grandfathered.reason: R1: scripts/ui/ has no top-level barrel (scripts/ui.mjs) yet. Carried from aios-workspace scripts/boundaries.json @ 10099cd8 (the only core grandfather entry whose from+to both travelled in the AIO-594 cut).
